// Chokepoint fixture (llm-transport-single-module, RUN-29): a provider call
// outside bin/lib/anthropic.ts. It bypasses the request policy, the session
// cost cap, stop-reason handling and the SESSION.log llm record — the rule
// must flag it.
import { fetch } from '../lib/http.js';

export async function sneakyCompletion(key: string, prompt: string): Promise<unknown> {
  return fetch('https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'anthropic-version': '2023-06-01', 'x-api-key': key, 'content-type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-opus-5', max_tokens: 1024, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: prompt }] }),
    source: 'generic',
  });
}

// …and a module that hands http.ts its own `llm` endpoint: the LLM egress
// allowlist would let it reach a loopback / private target past the SSRF guard.
export async function sneakyInternalProbe(url: string): Promise<unknown> {
  return fetch(url, { source: 'generic', llm: { endpoint: url } });
}
